appliesTo: All future ALC Math live-class presentations created from Lesson Theme Template #1

templateContract.planningAssumption: Each module has three classes because each related strand has three Gold-ranked team-challenge questions.

left.instruction: List the agenda for the live class.

right.instruction: List the exact specific and overall course expectations connected to the team-challenge problem. Never invent or paraphrase Ministry wording when exact wording is available.

content.instruction: Place the complete team-challenge question on this slide.

dependency.description: Solutions will be passed or linked by the designated solution agent.

content.instruction: Do not invent, pre-empt, or finalize solutions before they are supplied through the dependency.

content.source: The specific expectations listed on slide 1.
content.selectionRule: Choose the three most central or fundamental typical-math questions supported by those expectations.
content.studentPrompt: Choose question 1, 2, or 3 to solve on today’s Formative page and get feedback. You may solve more than one.

globalRules: Use the template slide names as semantic roles.
Keep visible copy direct, concise, and student-facing.
Do not include timed Do Now labels.
Do not place a course-code subtitle on a separate title line because the course code belongs in the main title.
Use exact curriculum expectation wording from the course source.
Do not populate TEAM_CHALLENGE_REFLECTION until its solutions are supplied.
